VPN Proxy Master helps protect your online privacy and secure your connection on Wi-Fi and mobile networks. Explore a global network of VPN servers with dedicated options for streaming, gaming, fixed IP connections, and multi-hop protection. Find the right server for your needs and connect with just one tap.

Features
- 6,700+ VPN servers worldwide
- Dedicated Video and Game servers for streaming and gaming
- Fixed IP servers for a consistent IP address
- Multi-hop servers for an additional layer of connection privacy
- Free Pick for quick, automatic connection to a free server
- Protect your privacy on public Wi-Fi hotspots
- Fast VPN connections for streaming and everyday browsing
- Advanced encryption protocols: OpenVPN, IKEv2, ShadowsocksR Enhanced, Wireguard Enhanced, etc.
- Simple setup with one-tap connection
- Strict no-logs policy
- 24/7 live chat support

Stay Secure Online
VPN Proxy Master encrypts your internet connection to help protect your online privacy and network traffic, especially when using public Wi-Fi hotspots. Browse with greater peace of mind at home, at school, or on the go.

Browse with More Privacy
VPN Proxy Master masks your real IP address to help protect your online identity. Enjoy a more private browsing experience while staying connected to the content and services you use.

Find the Right Server for You
Explore over 6,700 VPN servers worldwide with a clearer, more organized server list. Choose Video servers for streaming, Game servers for gaming, Fixed IP servers for a consistent IP address, or Multi-hop servers for an additional layer of connection privacy. With Free Pick, connect automatically to a free server in just a few taps, making it easy to get started.

Fast, Simple Connections
Connect to a VPN with just one tap. Browse, stream, and play with server options designed to suit different online activities, wherever you go.

24/7 Customer Support
Need help? Our support team is available 24/7 via live chat or email to assist you with your questions.


「Additional Subscription and Policy Information」:

- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase. 

- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at the time of purchase confirmation. All prices include applicable local taxes.

- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

- Your Apple Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. The renewal cost will be displayed before you are charged.

- Cancellation of the current subscription is not permitted during the active subscription period. But you can turn off auto-renewal to prevent future charges.

- Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

- All subscription-related actions must be managed by you through your Apple Account settings. We are unable to manage, modify, or cancel your subscription on your behalf.

- Check out our privacy policy and terms of use:
Privacy policy: https://vpnproxymaster.com/ios/privacy_policy.html
Terms of use: https://vpnproxymaster.com/ios/terms_of_use.html
